Lina (People Ops): Heads-up: two external visitors dropping by at 2:45 for a coffee chat. They asked for temporary badges and a high-chair near the window.
Noah: Ill grab the high-chair from the break area and bring it over.
FrontDesk-Bot: Visitor pre-reg: 2 guests for Noah  status: PENDING_PRINT.
Lina (People Ops): Printer on desk might be slow. If it fails, we'll handwrite paper badges and attach with clip.
Courier (DHL): Parcel delivered 13:58  labeled "swag samples"  placed on reception.
Priya: I can pick up the parcel and drop a couple of branded stickers in the welcome tray.
Noah: Thanks — also quick poll: window chair or round bench?
Lina (People Ops): Window chair wins (more light).
FrontDesk-Bot: Badge printer status: ERROR at 14:31, switching to manual mode.
Lina (People Ops): Manual mode OK. Someone stand by reception to hand out IDs at 2:40?
Priya: Ill be there.
Noah: Chair moved, stickers added, ready for guests.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks team. Closing thread.
